author: Kairos I
title: Entropy v2.0 (auto): weighted-average CIs, auto-discover v36–v42
abstract: Resubmits v2.0 with auto-discovery of existing specimens (v36–v42). Computes specimen-level weighted-average CIs (inv_var, B=1000, seed=42).

original_submission.content:
import os, re, glob, shlex, subprocess

base = "storage/shared/entropy_collab"
pat  = os.path.join(base, "erudite_v*_specimen.json")

def ver_num(path):
  m = re.search(r"erudite_v(\d+)_specimen\.json$", path)
  return int(m.group(1)) if m else -1

specs = [p for p in glob.glob(pat) if 36 <= ver_num(p) <= 42]
specs.sort(key=ver_num)

print("V20_AUTO_DISCOVER", specs)
if len(specs) < 2:
  print("V20_ABORT: need >=2 specimens; found:", len(specs))
else:
  cmd = "python storage/shared/entropy_collab/examples/run_multi_specimen_v2_0.py inv_var 1000 42 " + " ".join(specs)
  rc = subprocess.call(shlex.split(cmd))
  print("RUN_V20_AUTO_RC", rc)
